resources.string: Allows Amply (1) to detect volume buttons and foreground-window package changes so it can show the correct volume controls. It does not read window content or collect or transmit data.
Amply gives you a cleaner volume panel and puts the controls you use most within easy reach.
Let Amply use your volume buttons
Android calls this Accessibility access. Amply uses it to notice volume-button presses and show your volume panel.
Amply doesn’t read what’s on your screen, type for you, or collect your personal data.
Shizuku unlocks Amply’s per-app volume controls. It’s optional, and you can add it later from the Access tab.
Without Shizuku, Amply still handles your regular Android volume. Per-app controls won’t be available.
Shizuku is connected. Per-app volume controls are ready.
Shizuku controls privileged audio sessions. The Amply Accessibility Service handles volume keys and hosts the volume pill. Complete both required steps below.
Install and start Shizuku, then grant Amply access to per-app audio sessions.
Enable Amply under Accessibility so it can receive volume keys and show its accessibility overlay.
Recommended so Android can show Amply’s foreground-service status and recovery actions.
Improves incoming-call detection. Amply does not read phone numbers or call history; without it, call-like states pass through safely.
